Name: Transparent Dialogue Interface
Author: coldazrael
Description:
This mod is the reworked version of [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/transparent-dialogue-box.148805/]my older transparent dialogue box[/url], the older vanilla and mint blue theme is not available in this mod and will be reworked soon. Icons for relationship level indicator can be customized based on the information below :
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/18678/18678-1696955662-775694952.png[/img]

Left set is vanilla color style and right set is Harvest Moon color style (Vanilla rosebud style is not 100% vanilla because the green rosebud will blend with the sepals, early blue is changed to black and 2nd green is changed to blue)

[b]Installation :[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install Content Patcher if you havent installed it yet.
[*]Download the mod.
[*]Drop the mod folder ( [font=Courier New][CP] Transparent Dialogue Interface[/font] ) to Mods folder.
[*]Customize the mod config in [font=Courier New]config.json.[/font]
[/list][b] [/b]
[b]Optional after Installation :[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Choose, Download and install one of the recommended mods.
[*]Download the [font=Courier New]manifest.json[/font] in miscellanous based on the Recommended mod you installed.
[*]Drop the manifest.json in the mod folder [CP] Transparent Dialogue Interface and replace the previous one.
[/list]

[b]Config Options :[/b]
[list]
[*][i]DialogueFriendshipIndicatorShape[/i]
[/list] Sets the icon shape of dialogue friendship level 1-9, the values are : "Dots", "Hearts", or "Rosebud". Default : Dots
[list]
[*][i]MaxDialogueFriendshipIndicatorShape[/i]
[/list] ﻿Sets the icon shape of maximum friendship level (10+) in the dialogue interface, the values are :
﻿"IridiumStar", ﻿﻿﻿﻿"PrismaticHeart", ﻿or "RedRose". Default : RedRose
[list]
[*][i]DialogueFriendshipIndicatorStyle[/i]
[/list] ﻿Sets the color style of dialogue friendship level 1-9 in the dialogue interface, the values are : "Vanilla" or "Harvestmoon".
﻿Default : Vanilla

[b]Recommended Mods for Better Looking Overall Interface :
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]Vintage Interface v2[/url] by ManaKirel or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface[/url] by DaisyNiko
